parameters.jsCode:
const j=$json;
const prompt=[
 'Premium LinkedIn personal-brand editorial business poster background.',
 j.Visual_Scene+'.',
 j.Composition_Variant+'.',
 'Bright high-key natural daylight, airy premium atmosphere, clean off-white and warm light-gray base, refined navy or teal structure, subtle copper or warm amber accent chosen to suit the topic.',
 'Egyptian or Middle Eastern SME context where relevant, realistic business clothing and environments, sophisticated consulting aesthetic.',
 'Create one unmistakable visual idea, not a generic stock photo. Use depth, symbolism and visual storytelling appropriate to the post.',
 'Maximum two people. Natural anatomy, realistic hands and faces, credible proportions.',
 'Leave visually calm negative space in the upper area for a separate Arabic headline overlay.',
 'Absolutely no visible words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI text or readable chart text anywhere in the generated image.',
 'Charts if present must be abstract unlabeled shapes only.',
 'No dark cinematic grading, no clutter, no neon, no sci-fi holograms, no repeated template composition.',
 'Photorealistic editorial finish, polished commercial art direction.'
].join(' ');
return [{json:{...j,Image_Prompt_Final:prompt}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: $json.Image_Prompt_Final, negative_prompt: 'dark moody lighting, cinematic darkness, visible text, letters, words, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, fake UI text, oversaturated colors, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed faces, duplicate people, low resolution, clutter, generic stock-photo look, sci-fi holograms', num_steps: 20, guidance: 7, seed: Number($json.row_number || 42) + 4040 }) }}

parameters.name: =STAGING LinkedIn V4 Row {{ $('Pick Next Future Image Job').first().json.row_number }} - {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss') }}

parameters.url: =https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{{ $('Upload Base Image to Drive').first().json.id }}/permissions/{{ $('Grant Temporary Image Access').first().json.id }}
